facts.value: Colleges and universities may access applicants' internet services including social media profiles as part of their admissions process.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Peace Studies) - BA

facts.value: Students whose social media pages include questionable material may be disqualified from admission processes.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Peace Studies) - BA

facts.value: In July 2017, 11 percent of respondents in a survey reported that they had refused to admit an applicant based on social media content.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (Peace Studies) - BA

facts.value: The survey reported that 30 percent of institutions acknowledged reviewing the personal social media accounts of applicants at least some of the time.
